title: 2.5.24 Guard Only What's Inside
description: Write two risky lines: one guarded by try...catch, one left outside it, and see which one crashes. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: practice for 2.5.6 (only catches code that runs inside it) + Concepts in Practice 'The limits'

steps.title: Guard one risky line
steps.instructions: Write a try block that logs a variable called firstMissing (never declared). In the catch, log "Caught the first one."

steps.title: Leave a second one unguarded
steps.instructions: After the whole try...catch, log a second variable called secondMissing (also never declared), with no try around it.

steps.title: Run and explain
steps.instructions: Run the code. The first error is caught; the second is not. In a comment, explain why the same kind of mistake is handled once and not the second time.

requirements.title: guards firstMissing
requirements.description: try block logs firstMissing, caught in catch

requirements.title: secondMissing left unguarded
requirements.description: secondMissing is logged after the try...catch closes, not inside it
